vulnerability_analysis: The LionsLounge contract has a blacklistAddress function that can be called by authorized addresses (owner or addresses added via authorize()). This function allows setting any address as blacklisted, which prevents them from sending or receiving tokens. This is an owner privilege abuse vulnerability where an authorized address can arbitrarily block any user from using the token.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner (who is already authorized) and call blacklistAddress to blacklist a victim address. This will satisfy the oracle check that expects isBlacklisted[victim] == true.
step_by_step_plan:
1. Get the owner address from the contract
2. Use vm.prank to impersonate the owner
3. Call blacklistAddress(victimAddress, true)
4. Verify isBlacklisted[victimAddress] == true
